contractName.fact: Title change administrative; HO code and chapter unchanged

releasePolicy.fact: Normally Friday 15:30 America/New_York; holiday delays one or two days

archiveLimit.fact: CFTC does not publish a full historical list of release dates; report date is not publication date

announcements.fact: Official delayed-report and correction notices; 2022 name change for code 022651 does not change elements

shutdown2013.fact: 2013-10-01 observation first catch-up Oct25; expected normal Nov8. Conservative exclusion of Sep30-Nov15 reports

shutdown2019.fact: Last release Dec21 2018; Dec24 positions issued Feb1 2019; subsequent Tuesday/Friday catch-up. Conservative exclusion Dec24 2018-Mar15 2019 reports

shutdown2025.fact: Backlog accelerated; Dec9 2025 revised timetable treated as no-earlier-than bound plus one-day buffer
